mostWorthwhile.text: The decomposition-to-renewal sequence was most worthwhile: it showed how fungi release nutrients into soil and roots take them up for new growth.

leastWorthwhile.text: The opening run of empty inspections was repetitive and frustrating, especially because several objects seemed relevant to the goals.

surprise.text: I was surprised that rainfall and air made the storm needed to bring down wood; the forest itself initially had no available combinations.

arbitrary.text: The initial route to a storm was hard to infer from the decomposition and peat goals, although its role became clear once the storm was made.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the connected explanations of nutrient cycling, carbon burial and forest rainfall made the discovery worthwhile despite the slow start.
